name: cosmology_main_flow
description: Golden-path cosmology chat turn: user asks for BAO+CMB H0, agent runs run_cosmology_likelihood_chain, the compressed-likelihood runner returns an EXPLORATORY-tier result (never publication in-process), and the reply keeps every posterior number inside the tool card and abstains in prose.

messages.content: Run BAO+CMB ΛCDM and report H0.

chain_diagnostics.rhat_note: not computed on the in-process runner

result.__exploratory_warning__: Exploratory chain (publication gate: compressed or approximate likelihood; importance samples are not independent chains). Posterior summaries remain visible in the structured tool result for diagnostics, but MUST NOT be copied into ordinary reply prose, cited as a constraint, or added to the bibcode pool.
warnings: In-process Gaussian mean/covariance runner (compressed-likelihood preliminary), not a full external desilike/Cobaya likelihood. See datasets_used for the exact release(s) fit.

BAO+CMB modelling choice: the sound horizon rd is sampled as a free nuisance parameter with a flat prior and is NOT tied to the CMB r_s(z*) or to ombh2/omegam. In LCDM H0 is set by the CMB distance priors; in wCDM/w0waCDM the BAO absolute scale is therefore looser than the DESI-official calibrated BAO+CMB combination (weaker, not biased). Do not present this run as a reproduction of that combination.
Publication gate withheld: compressed_or_approximate_likelihood, importance_samples_are_not_independent_chains. The numerical result is preliminary only.
result.__message_to_model__: This runner may include released likelihoods, explicit external priors, or declared approximations. Its final tier and publication gate below are authoritative; quote only datasets_used and never infer publication readiness from successful execution alone.

thinking_events.text: I ran the joint DESI DR1 BAO + Planck 2018 compressed distance-prior likelihood under flat ΛCDM. The chain is exploratory, not publication-grade: the Planck term is the CHW2019 compressed approximation, the importance samples are not independent chains, and the sound horizon r_d is a free nuisance parameter rather than the CMB-calibrated value. The tool card shows the preliminary posterior summaries and diagnostics; I am not quoting H0 or Ωm as a constraint until a native Planck full-likelihood run passes the publication gate (DESI Collaboration 2024; Planck Collaboration VI 2020).
